##### Project general facts

Vasana Residence is a premium villa development by Kaluna, a developer with over a decade of experience and more than a hundred villas delivered across Bali. The project offers a secure one-gate system and a well-planned area. Featuring two and three-bedroom villas on spacious plots, Vasana combines thoughtful design with flexible customization options, allowing buyers to personalize their home to suit their style while maximizing comfort and investment value.

Residents enjoy close proximity to a range of lifestyle amenities. Walking beach access, cafes and restaurants, schools, and sports activities are all nearby. Health care and wellness centers are within easy reach, including a general hospital, fitness center, surf school, padel court, pilates studio, and horse riding. The area is rapidly developing, with land values experiencing significant appreciation, reflecting strong growth and rising demand for premium residential and tourism real estate.

Vasana Residence offers three furnishing levels: semi-furnished, fully-furnished, and ready-to-operate. Semi-furnished includes a kitchen set, living room furniture, sanitary ware, and basic landscaping. Fully-furnished adds TVs, bedroom furniture, dining sets, water heaters, and outdoor sun loungers. Ready-to-operate includes all the above plus linens, curtains, decorative art, cutlery, bathroom amenities, and tropical gardens. Finishes feature granite flooring, wood or veneer accents, Jotun paints, German sanitary ware, and Eurostar pool pumps, ensuring lasting quality and effortless turnkey living.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Kedungu, Tabanan, this exceptional location places residents in one of Bali’s fastest-growing and most promising coastal areas. Since recent years, land prices in the region have surged dramatically, reflecting rapid development and rising demand for premium residential and tourism real estate. Kedungu is a flourishing neighborhood designed for residential comfort, offering a peaceful yet well-connected environment.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and natural beauty. Kedungu Beach is within walking distance, offering stunning black sand shores and world-class surf breaks. The area is also home to a growing number of cafes, restaurants, international schools, fitness centers, wellness facilities, and sports activities, making it highly attractive for families, digital nomads, and investors alike.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal charm, rapid growth potential, and modern convenience, Kedungu delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, emerging infrastructure, and strong appreciation trends makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, connected and strategically positioned for long-term value.
